metadata.description: Personal Claude Plugin Marketplace for Stuart A. Malone

plugins.name: 1Password
plugins.description: Securely work with 1Password through the op CLI. Manage vaults, items, and secrets without exposing plaintext values to Claude.

plugins.name: beads-tools
plugins.description: Beads (bd) Dolt workflow toolkit: the bd-mode embedded/server switcher CLI, a deterministic config-audit skill + script, and git hooks that sync Dolt data on push/pull.

plugins.name: personal-project
plugins.description: Workflow profile for single-maintainer personal projects: temporary branches instead of PRs, automatic code-review and simplification passes, and merge/cleanup conventions.

plugins.name: beads-workflow
plugins.description: Workflow profile for beads (bd) projects: claiming, closing vs. merging, gates, discovered work, and multi-worktree rules. Self-gating — emits nothing unless a .beads/ directory is found.

plugins.name: beads-config-audit
plugins.description: Audit and repair a beads (bd) project's Dolt configuration to a single-user preferred state: JSONL export off, a refs/dolt/data remote, mode-appropriate auto-push, backup git-push off, and clean health checks.
